in_sanskrit.name: Vanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of fertility and abundance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Vanya is derived from the word 'vanyā' meaning 'forest' or 'wild'. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Shakti, who is the embodiment of fertility, abundance, and power. Vanya is believed to represent the untamed and powerful aspects of nature, making it a name full of strength and vitality.
